scope: Original parametric display surfaces for a complete visible dashboard concept. DDK photographs guide component hierarchy and qualitative shape only. All positions, section stations, angles and radii are artistic assumptions, never vehicle coordinates or measured interfaces.
photo_observation_limits: RHD DDK car and LHD GT2 comparator do not establish the exact M564 target. No third-party pixels, traced contours or calibrated photogrammetry are used.
ancestry: Replaces photo-study-v1 visual geometry with newly authored display surfaces; prior tracked trim STL is not reused or overwritten.
design_decisions: Upper pad and variable-height instrument brow overlap into one visual silhouette instead of a detached capsule.
Side vent faces move into the lower fascia and use vertical blades as observed in the completed DDK interior; centre vent retains horizontal blades.
Passenger glovebox becomes shallow above a continuous rounded lower band.
Radio/HVAC remain in the fascia below centre vent; lower tunnel console is a separately sloped display surface.
Gauge diameter ratios follow existing 80:100:115:100:80 product-size leads as visual proportions only; face marks are symbolic.
